summary: Iter23 tested end-to-end: 4 new features (Quote Templates, Multi-Plan PDF, Email Open Tracking, Signature Flow). 11/11 backend tests pass. Frontend public /sign/:token flow works end-to-end (canvas drawing → submit → sign-done → PDF download link). PlanTakeoff templates picker, template save controls and multi-quote dialog all render with correct data-testids.

integration_issues.issue: When opening multi-quote-dialog immediately after uploading a plan, allPlans list is empty ('Aucun plan disponible' displayed) — plans list endpoint may not include just-uploaded plan or dialog doesn't refresh. Existing plans uploaded via API in prior tests should have appeared. Non-blocking but worth verifying: is the plans list fetched on dialog open?

action_items: (Optional/minor) Verify that the multi-quote dialog fetches / refreshes the plans list when opened so newly uploaded plans (and all plans owned by user) appear as checkboxes.
critical_code_review_comments: SignatureIn.signature_b64 min_length=100 rejects the 91-char 1x1 PNG example given in the review request. In the frontend it's fine because canvas.toDataURL always produces > 100 chars. Consider lowering min_length to 50 or documenting it clearly.

quote_router.get('/track/open/{log_id}') never returns 404 for unknown log_id (swallows exceptions and returns pixel anyway). This is correct behaviour for a tracking pixel (avoid leaking info) — good.
create_signature_link endpoint returns URL relative ('/sign/{token}') when FRONTEND_URL env is missing. In current env FRONTEND_URL is set so absolute URL is returned — OK.
PlanTakeoff.jsx is 1724 lines — consider splitting (Devis dialog, Multi dialog, Sends history) into subcomponents for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — SignQuote flow 100%, PlanTakeoff testids all present, minor issue with multi-plans-list being empty on immediate open
